data.action: 双手轻扶铁丝网侧立，晚风将及踝金色长发大面积吹拂卷起，红眸凝望远方落日
data.description: 彩南高中空无一人的天台铁丝网边，金红色的壮烈夕阳席卷长空。小暗双手扶着微凉的铁网护栏侧立，晚风将她足足有数米长、及踝的金色秀发大面积吹拂飞散开来，在落日余晖中宛如一轮金色的烈日幕布。她侧过脸庞，红瞳静静注视着远方，展现出顶级刺客孤独而又向往光明的复杂心境。
data.lighting: 浓烈壮丽的金红晚霞逆光穿透发丝形成的剔透轮廓光晕
data.location: 学园高空天台铁丝网边缘
data.promptProse: Standing alone beside the chain-link fence on the empty school rooftop in her black leather gothic mini-dress and detached flared sleeves, Golden Darkness rests both hands lightly against the cool metal wire. High evening gusts sweep her ankle-length hair wide across the crimson sunset sky like a billowing golden curtain as she gazes silently out toward the distant horizon. Intense crimson-gold backlight cuts through her streaming hair and casts a sharp luminous rim along the rooftop rail.
data.title: 金色暗影 · 暮色天台的金晖拂面
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the rooftop chain-link fence in her black leather gothic dress, she rests both hands on the wire and gazes toward the horizon as sunset gusts sweep her long hair across the sky. Fierce crimson-gold backlight rims her silhouette from a low wide angle.
